name: Wall of Hurricane Winds
body:
School evocation [air]; Level: sorcerer/wizard 7, summoner 7, storm knight 7

Components: V, S, M (a twig from a tree destroyed by a wind storm)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Effect: Wall of hurricane-force winds up to 10 ft. long/level or a ring of wind with a radius of up to 5 ft. per two levels; either form 20 ft. high.

Duration: Concentration

Saving Throw: None; Spell Resistance: yes

This spell creates a wall of hurricane-force wind. The wall cannot be formed in an area occupied by creatures or objects. One side of the wall (your choice) emits the hurricane-force winds, the other side is calm. The windy side of the wall has all the effects of a hurricane to everything within 10 feet of it.

This spell can be made permanent with a permanency spell.
